fluff.overview: The LCAF fields conventional infantry that benefit from the Commonwealth's deep industrial base, equipping even garrison formations with reliable, well-maintained weapons and transport. Mechanized tracked platoons deploy from armored personnel carriers that provide protection during movement and allow the formation to keep pace with heavier combat vehicles in offensive operations. Armed with assault rifles backed by portable machine guns, these platoons combine individual marksmanship with sustained suppressive fire from crew-served weapons that can pin down opposing formations.
